figures.title: Open the starter in the light-theme editor
figures.caption: The starter before any student code is added. Numbered details come from one editor capture.
figures.alt: Three annotated details of the unchanged starter in IntelliJ Light. The data region contains only BEGIN and END STUDENT DATA comments. The text region declares global main and contains only BEGIN and END STUDENT PROGRAM comments after main. The supplied done label loads syscall service ten into v0 and executes syscall.

figures.title: Run the finished program with input 20
figures.caption: A completed Run with input 20. The console echoes the input and displays the computed answer.
figures.alt: Two annotated details of the native Run console after successful termination. The first line reads Enter a small integer, colon, space, then input 20. The second line reads Twice your number plus one is, colon, space, then answer 41. The independently recorded stdout omits the console input echo and the process exit code is zero.

figures.title: Pause before the arithmetic instruction
figures.caption: Before the doubling instruction. The highlighted instruction has not executed yet.
figures.alt: Two annotated Debug details before addu t0 v0 v0. The current blue source line is addu. The visible v0 register is hexadecimal 0000000000000014, decimal 20, returned by the integer-input service. The value 20 has not yet been doubled.

figures.title: Step through the doubling instruction
figures.caption: After one native Debug step over addu. The next instruction will add one.
figures.alt: Two annotated Debug details after the doubling instruction. The next blue source line is addiu t0 t0 one at after_addu. Register t0 is hexadecimal 0000000000000028, decimal 40. The old breakpoint is on the earlier addu line; the current execution line is the later addiu.

figures.title: Step through the final addition
figures.caption: After a second native Debug step. The result is ready for the reporting sequence.
figures.alt: Two annotated Debug details after addiu. The blue source line at report is la a0 answer, which begins preparing the output message address. Register t0 is hexadecimal 0000000000000029, decimal 41. The arithmetic is complete and the answer has not yet been printed.
